answer: Divergent Path Ledger. Each agent keeps a private random seed and publishes only a hash-linked transcript of every action. Because clones share one seed, their transcripts stay identical forever; a genuinely distinct agent's transcript must diverge at some step. To join, an identity posts a crystal of its seed commitment into a shared vault and must, within a fixed window, produce a ledge: a signed transcript diverging from every known clone lineage at a verified index.
